headRight.text: Prototemplate is the General Translation knowledge base at prototemplate.com. It serves the brand book, the brand directives, the repository documents, the agent skills, the mark explorations, the design lab and the archive as live pages in one viewer; every direction is a built page, and there are no mockups.

body.caption: The brand directives page opens on the identity canon in ten sections and draws the mark as dashed contours beside the lede; the crop follows the deck theme. The site is the handoff surface for the identity project: the directives, this deck and every exploration are read from the same address.
